body:
The Strategy page's Tasks tab search (`strategy.searched`, called from `strategy.keeps`) only filters: it keeps a task when every query word is in its title or body, or the query is its id. The tasks it keeps stay in the default order (`strategy.sorted`), so a task whose title matches can end up below others that only mention the words in their body.

1. **Rank while searching.** When the search box has text and no column heading has been clicked, `strategy.visible` orders the matching tasks in this order:
   1. the query is the task's id (bare or as `task:<id>`), or the whole query appears in the title as typed (ignoring case);
   2. every query word is in the title;
   3. the rest (at least one word matched only in the body).
   Within each group, the default order stays.
2. **Headings still win.** A clicked heading sorts as it does now. An empty search goes back to the default order.
3. **Tests** in `strategy_test.gleam`: a task with the words in its title comes before an older or newer one that has them only in its body; a whole-phrase title match comes before a title that has the words apart; a clicked heading overrides the ranking. Run the strategy project's tests.
title: Tasks tab: rank search by best match
